# Every act in this repository

19213 acts, 30,796 versions. Each act lives in a folder named by its official identifier, `<kind>/<year>/<number>/` (Legea nr. 31/1990 is `lege/1990/31/`); its README.md lists its articles and the decisions made by hand. Dates are in-force days. Generated on every publish; the same list is in [data/acts.json](data/acts.json). This page lists the primary legislation; every other kind is listed by year (local acts: by council and year) under [data/acts/](data/acts/) (see [Other kinds](#other-kinds)), and [data/index.json](data/index.json) names every file.
